commands.documentation: <<scene_transition "Classroom">>: does nothing when the location is this scene, so a node can open with the scene it belongs to. Otherwise it loads that scene and the dialogue never continues here: the rest of the node (such as a <<jump>>) is left to the next scene, which plays its own start node with YarnCutscene. Location names ignore case, spaces, and underscores, so "music_room" loads the MusicRoom scene. <<scene_transition "Classroom" "door">> also plays the Sounds entry "door" as the transition starts closing. It plays on the CircleTransition, so the sound is not cut off when this scene unloads.
<<advance_time "lunch">>: covers the screen, switches the time slot (ActiveDuringTime objects follow), uncovers it.
<<fade>>: covers and uncovers the screen. <<fade "out">> and <<fade "in">> only log for now: the scene transitions next to them already cover and uncover the screen.
<<cutscene "anin_joins_table">>: plays the matching Timeline and waits for it to finish.
<<hard_reset>>: white flash, then the loop starts over at midnight (the gap): start nodes play again, and Scene After Hard Reset loads, even when it is this scene. Yarn variables are kept.
<<soft_reset>>: midnight comes without a death, so there is no white flash. The loop starts over in the Dorm at midnight.
<<end_gap>>: the gap is over and Dec 10 starts again in the Dorm, in the morning.
